column1: # Irregular verbs, first batch — 25 of the most common.
# Forms go in the term itself, comma-separated: the production card then asks for
# all three at once, which is the knowledge that makes a verb irregular.
# When answering, forms may be separated by commas or by spaces ("go went gone").
# The card is recognised as a verb by this shape — exactly three single words —
# and says "Напишите три формы глагола" instead of asking for a word.
# Do NOT use "/" here — it marks interchangeable alternatives, so "go / went / gone"
# would accept "went" alone as a complete answer. Verbs with two past forms
# (be — was/were) are left out of this scheme for that reason.
